  - sync.isEnabled() returns whether client Sync is enabled, and returns false when the service worker is off.

  - sync.hasInitialSyncCompleted() returns whether the initial client synchronization has completed.
  - sync.isEnabled() returns false when SB_DISABLE_SERVICE_WORKER is set or the browser has no service worker.
